faqs.question: What are your shop opening hours and timings?
faqs.answer: Grand Royal Hotel is open Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM and Sundays from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

faqs.question: Where are you located and how do I get directions?
faqs.answer: We are conveniently located in the central market area. You can tap the "Directions" button above to view our live location on Google Maps.

faqs.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all convenient payment modes including Cash, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), and Credit/Debit Cards.

faqs.question: Do you offer home delivery or shipping?
faqs.answer: Yes, local delivery is available for orders within our service area. Please reach out on WhatsApp to check delivery time and minimum order details.

faqs.question: How can I contact or message you directly?
faqs.answer: You can reach out to us directly by tapping the "WhatsApp" or "Call" buttons on this screen for instant assistance.
